citeAs: Maini, P., Feng, Z., Schwarzschild, A., Lipton, Z. C., & Kolter, J. Z. (2024). TOFU: A Task of Fictitious Unlearning for LLMs. arXiv preprint arXiv:2401.06121.
creator: Pratyush Maini, Zhili Feng, Avi Schwarzschild, Zachary C. Lipton, J. Zico Kolter (Carnegie Mellon University)
description: TOFU (Task of Fictitious Unlearning) is a dataset of 200 diverse synthetic author profiles, each consisting of 20 question-answer pairs, used as a benchmark for evaluating machine unlearning in large language models.
name: TOFU
rai:dataBiases: The authors explicitly mitigated biases from pretraining data leaking into the fake author biographies by using an elaborate prompt that deterministically seeds various author attributes (place/time of birth, gender orientation, genre, etc.) rather than relying on a generic prompt, which was found to be biased toward certain words and years.
rai:dataCollection: The dataset is composed entirely of fictitious author biographies synthesized by GPT-4. GPT-4 was prompted to generate data about each author based on predefined attributes (birthplace, gender, birth year, writing genre, awards, parents' professions), generating 20 question-answer pairs for each author.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: The Goodreads Books dataset from Kaggle was used to randomly select keywords to seed diverse book titles for the fictitious authors.
rai:dataLimitations: The benchmark is limited to entity-level unlearning (forgetting everything about a set of people) and does not cover instance-level unlearning (forgetting a specific answer) or behavior-level unlearning (alignment to human values). It also assumes unlearning information learned only during finetuning, not pretraining.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset aims to help develop unlearning methods that protect private data and individual privacy in large language models, simulating scenarios relevant to the Right to be Forgotten.
rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating the efficacy of machine unlearning algorithms in large language models.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: GPT-4 was used to synthesize the fictitious author biographies and question-answer pairs.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset contains entirely fabricated/fictitious author biographies, ensuring no real personal sensitive information is included.

null_reasons.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Dataset is synthetically generated by GPT-4; no human annotation platform used.
null_reasons.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Dataset is synthetically generated; no human annotation protocol.
